flags.reason: Checked on jfs-components 0.1.77 (2026-09-28); the installed package is 0.1.78. Re-check before relying on it.

Two guides offer an action menu. This guide's summary uses Dropdown Menu for “a short list of actions that opens from a button, such as an overflow or account menu”, while the Dropdown guide (889444e) uses Dropdown for “a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field”, and its In context is the same overflow menu on a September statement card (Download statement, Share statement, Report a problem); the Dropdown entry's useWhen says so too. Neither guide says which one an action menu uses, so this entry doesn't decide it: it gives no avoidWhen for Dropdown, and the Dropdown entry none for Dropdown Menu. The question is open in guide fixes #523 (the Dropdown guide) and #554 (this guide), for Marcin; once a guide answers it, re-extract both entries. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r25, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: The guide's In context, an overflow menu on a statement card, with the menu open under the card's More button. The rows are the guide's Actions with icons menu: each has an Icon and no chevron (showTrailing false), since each row acts in place. The More button's onPress stands for the screen opening the menu, and each row's onPress for running that action and closing the menu; Dropdown Menu only draws the panel.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <HStack alignVertical="center" justifyHorizontal="space-between">
    <Text>September statement</Text>
    <IconButton iconName="ic_more_vertical" accessibilityLabel="More actions" onPress={() => {}} />
  </HStack>
  <DropdownMenu accessibilityLabel="Statement actions" style={{ width: 256 }}>
    <DropdownMenu.Item label="Download statement" leading={<Icon iconName="ic_download" />} showTrailing={false} onPress={() => {}} />
    <DropdownMenu.Item label="Share statement" leading={<Icon iconName="ic_share" />} showTrailing={false} onPress={() => {}} />
    <DropdownMenu.Item label="Edit details" leading={<Icon iconName="ic_edit" />} showTrailing={false} onPress={() => {}} />
    <DropdownMenu.Item label="Report a problem" leading={<Icon iconName="ic_info" />} showTrailing={false} onPress={() => {}} />
  </DropdownMenu>
</Card>

props.name: children
props.description: Menu rows — typically {@link DropdownMenuItem} children. Maps to the Figma composition of `Menu Item` instances inside the surface.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height before the menu body scrolls.

props.name: DropdownMenu.Item
props.description: A static sub-component of DropdownMenu. Its own props: label, children, leading, trailing, showLeading, showTrailing, selected, disabled, onPress, modes, style, labelStyle, accessibilityLabel, accessibilityHint, disableTruncation.

props.name: DropdownMenu.Item.selected
props.description: On DropdownMenu.Item: marks the current row. On the web it reaches only accessibilityState, which react-native-web 0.21 does not turn into aria-selected (the 8 October check read this from the installed source; not browser-checked).

props.name: DropdownMenu.Item.showTrailing
props.description: On DropdownMenu.Item: shows the default trailing chevron (ic_chevron_right) when trailing is not given; true by default.
